modules.title: Atomistic materials calculations
modules.expensive_path: Neighbour enumeration, interatomic energy and derivative evaluation, elastic response and coupled material calculations.
modules.rationale: One source distribution and test suite share ASE atom states, neighbour infrastructure and calculator interfaces. Physical families remain check families in a whole-codebase module.
modules.purpose: matscipy computes atomistic material properties and configurations, including elastic response, interatomic energies and derivatives, fracture and dislocations, structural statistics, and electrochemical concentration profiles.
primary_inputs: Atomic species, positions, simulation cells and boundary conditions
Ionic concentrations, charges, electrode potentials and domain dimensions
primary_outputs: Elastic tensors, atomic strains and defect configurations
algorithm_stages: Construct atomic configurations or continuum boundary-value problems
Enumerate neighbours and evaluate physical interactions
Compute derivatives, relax configurations or solve concentration equations
Return physical fields, tensors and structural observables
unique_responsibilities: One whole-codebase module owns the library and its official tests and examples.
not_responsible_for: Implementation of external ASE, NumPy, SciPy, Atomistica, QUIP, FEniCS or LAMMPS packages
modules.differences: There are no sibling modules. Physical families share neighbour infrastructure, atom states and calculator interfaces.
